exposure: endovascular balloon occlusion of the abdominal aorta (EBOAA)
cohort: The study included 38 pregnant women diagnosed with placenta previa/percreta 3b and 3c types who underwent cesarean section.
finding: Endovascular balloon occlusion of the abdominal aorta (EBOAA) significantly reduced blood loss, surgery time, and hospital stays compared to internal iliac artery ligation (IIAL) in managing placenta previa/percreta 3b and 3c during cesarean section.
